description: Search emails in one iCloud Mail mailbox (default INBOX) by sender, recipient, subject, full text, received date range, unread and flagged state. Returns newest first with paging (total, nextOffset) and, per message: uid, date, from, replyTo (when it differs from from; confirm which to answer), to, cc, subject, seen, flagged, hasAttachments, size. Criteria combine with AND. Reading results never marks mail read. Use the uid with apple_mail_get_message. Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (app-specific password), and ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS unless the Apple ID is an @icloud.com/@me.com/@mac.com address.

before.description: Only mail RECEIVED before this date/time (exclusive); same formats as since.

flagged.description: true = only flagged, false = only unflagged.

from.description: Sender contains this text (name or address).

mailbox.description: Mailbox path as listed by apple_mail_list_mailboxes (e.g. "INBOX", "Sent Messages", "Work/Receipts"), or an alias: inbox, sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item to return (default 0). Use the nextOffset from the previous page.

since.description: Only mail RECEIVED at or after this date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (local time in timeZone), or with Z/offset.

text.description: Full-text match anywhere in the message (body or headers).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for dates you pass and dates returned (default: DISPLAY_TZ).

to.description: A To recipient contains this text.

unread.description: true = only unread, false = only read.

name: apple_mail_search
title: Search iCloud Mail
